title: AW27 Boys' Season Colour Analysis
summary: AW27 boyswear colour: greyed blue and oat with waxy ochre and sage, plum for the newness.
research_period: Pitti Filati, June 2026; Première Vision, Lineapelle and Milano Unica, September 2026; forecaster reports to November 2026

sections.heading: How this forecast was built
sections.body: Pre-fair forecast. The AW27 kidswear fairs (Pitti Bimbo and Playtime Paris) take place in January 2027. This report applies the 2026 adult yarn, fabric and leather fair evidence and the AW26 kidswear fair record to kidswear, and will be updated after the fairs.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body:
- At Première Vision, deep violet, plums, dusty pinks, mauves and tinted off-blacks set the tone; violet is "centre stage", and plum and deep red become alternatives to black<sup>[1]</sup>
- Pink and mauve are becoming gender-neutral, reaching menswear and even junior sweatshirts<sup>[1]</sup>
- Forecut's AW27 colour forecast: violet, plum and tannic bordeaux replace black over tinted neutrals<sup>[2]</sup>

Confirm codes against a physical Pantone book before dyeing.

sections.heading: Colour groups
sections.body:
- **Core:** greyed blue, oat.
- **Seasonal:** plum.
- **Accent:** waxy ochre, sage.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Adult fairs put violet, plum and dusty pinks at the centre and note pink and mauve reaching junior sweatshirts; Forecut's kidswear palette applies that with brighter ochre and sage for play.

design_implications:
- Test plum and mauve on cotton jersey and fleece; check colour fastness to washing.
- Safety: no drawstrings or long cords at the hood, neck or waist, in line with EN 14682; test the attachment strength of buttons, snaps and decorations, and keep small detachable parts off baby and toddler pieces.
commercial_implications: - Greyed blue and oat carry volume; plum and mauve are the newness.
